run_ping_server: run the ping_server script to continuously poll and publish robot state timestamps to a0
create_a0_publisher: create an a0.Publisher instance to publish data to a named topic like latest_robot_state
connect_robot_interface: connect to the Polymetis server by instantiating polymetis.RobotInterface
get_robot_state: retrieve the current robot state using robot_interface.get_robot_state and access its timestamp
publish_robot_timestamp: publish the robot state timestamp seconds to an a0 publisher using publisher.pub
